#Mean dFF across entire behaviour
```{r}
# =========================
# Libraries
# =========================
library(pacman)
p_load(tidyverse, readr, lmerTest, emmeans)

# =========================
# Load data
# =========================
df <- read_csv("social_NE_lmer_ready.csv")

# =========================
# Filter for Social_interaction ONLY
# =========================
df <- df %>%
  filter(behavior == "Social_interaction")

# df <- df %>%
#   filter(behavior == "Social_interaction", week != "W3")

# =========================
# Format variables
# =========================
df$week <- as.factor(df$week)
df$mouse_id <- as.factor(df$mouse_id)

# Ensure correct order
df$week <- factor(df$week,
                  levels = c("Preinduction", "W1", "W2", "W3"))

# =========================
# Linear mixed model
# =========================
m_anova <- lmerTest::lmer(mean_dFF ~ week + (1 | mouse_id), data = df)

summary(m_anova)
# Emmeans + Dunnett contrasts
# =========================
emmeans_results <- emmeans(m_anova, ~ week)

dunnett_results <- contrast(
  emmeans_results,
  method = "trt.vs.ctrl",
  ref = 1
)

dunnett_table <- as.data.frame(summary(dunnett_results, infer = TRUE))
print(dunnett_table)

# =========================
# SIGNIFICANCE ANNOTATION (DUNNETT)
# =========================

dunnett_table$group <- c("W1", "W2", "W3")
#dunnett_table$group <- c("W1", "W2")

# =========================
# Summary stats for plotting
# =========================
summary_df <- df %>%
  group_by(week) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(mean_dFF, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(mean_dFF, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# y-position above bars
y_max <- max(summary_df$mean + summary_df$se)

dunnett_table$y <- c(
  y_max * 1.20,
  y_max * 1.30,
  y_max * 1.40
)
# dunnett_table$y <- c(
#   y_max * 1.20,
#   y_max * 1.30
# )

dunnett_table$label <- case_when(
  dunnett_table$p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
  dunnett_table$p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
  dunnett_table$p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
  TRUE ~ "ns"
)
dunnett_table

# =========================
# Summary stats for plotting
# =========================
summary_df <- df %>%
  group_by(week) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(mean_dFF, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(mean_dFF, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# =========================
# Plot
# =========================
library(ggplot2)

plot_bar <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = week, y = mean, fill = week)) +

  geom_col(width = 0.6, color = "black", alpha = 0.85) +

  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    data = df,
    aes(x = week, y = mean_dFF),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    width = 0.08,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  geom_line(
    data = df,
    aes(x = week, y = mean_dFF, group = mouse_id),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "gray60",
    alpha = 0.4,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Preinduction" = "#feca8d",
    "W1" = "#f1605d",
    "W2" = "#440f76"
  )) +

  labs(
    x = "Week",
    y = "Mean ΔF/F"
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    text = element_text(size = 14)
  )+
  geom_text(
  data = dunnett_table,
  aes(x = group, y = y, label = label),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  size = 5
)

plot_bar

# =========================
# Save figure
# =========================
# ggsave(
#   "NE_SocialInteraction_barplot.svg",
#   plot = plot_bar,
#   width = 8,
#   height = 6
# )

# =========================
# Model diagnostics
# =========================
p_load(performance)
check_model(m_anova)

qqnorm(residuals(m_anova))
qqline(residuals(m_anova))

shapiro.test(residuals(m_anova))
```

# power analysis of obtained


```{r}
# =========================
# Libraries
# =========================
library(tidyverse)
library(lmerTest)   # <- main model engine
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(future.apply)

# =========================
# Ensure correct ordering
# =========================
df$week <- factor(df$week,
                  levels = c("Preinduction", "W1", "W2", "W3"))

df$mouse_id <- as.factor(df$mouse_id)

# =========================
# Fit model (lmerTest)
# =========================
m_anova <- lmerTest::lmer(
  mean_dFF ~ week + (1 | mouse_id),
  data = df
)

# =========================
# Simulation settings
# =========================
n_simulations <- 1000

plan(multisession,
     workers = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 2))

# =========================
# Power simulation
# =========================
results <- future_lapply(1:n_simulations, function(i) {

  # -------------------------
  # SAFE simulation from fitted model
  # -------------------------
  mf <- model.frame(m_anova)

  sim_values <- simulate(m_anova, nsim = 1, re.form = NULL)[,1]

  sim_df <- mf
  sim_df$mean_dFF <- sim_values

  sim_df$week <- factor(sim_df$week,
                        levels = levels(df$week))
  sim_df$mouse_id <- factor(sim_df$mouse_id)

  # -------------------------
  # refit model (lmerTest)
  # -------------------------
  m_sim <- tryCatch(
    lmerTest::lmer(mean_dFF ~ week + (1 | mouse_id), data = sim_df),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  # -------------------------
  # Dunnett-style contrasts
  # -------------------------
  get_pvals <- function(model) {

    if (is.null(model)) return(rep(NA, 3))

    em <- emmeans(model, ~ week)

    contrast_out <- contrast(
      em,
      method = "trt.vs.ctrl",
      ref = 1
    )

    summary(contrast_out)$p.value
  }

  list(
    p = get_pvals(m_sim),
    singular = if (!is.null(m_sim)) isSingular(m_sim) else NA
  )

}, future.seed = TRUE)

# =========================
# Extract results
# =========================
p_mat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results, function(x) x$p))

colnames(p_mat) <- c("W1_vs_Pre", "W2_vs_Pre", "W3_vs_Pre")
#colnames(p_mat) <- c("W1_vs_Pre", "W2_vs_Pre")

# =========================
# POWER SUMMARY
# =========================
power_summary <- colMeans(p_mat < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

print("Estimated Power (lmerTest + Dunnett):")
print(power_summary)

# =========================
# MODEL STABILITY
# =========================
singular_rate <- mean(sapply(results, function(x) x$singular), na.rm = TRUE)

cat("\nSingular fit rate:", singular_rate, "\n")
```


```{r}
# =========================
# Libraries
# =========================
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(simr)

# =========================
# Fit model
# =========================
design <- lmer(
  mean_dFF ~ week + (1 | mouse_id),
  data = df
)

summary(design)

# =========================
# Set number of simulations
# =========================
nsim <- 1000

# =========================
# Power simulation
# (choose ONE contrast at a time)
# =========================

# W1 vs Pre
power_W1 <- powerSim(
  design,
  test = fixed("weekW1", "t"),
  nsim = nsim
)

# W2 vs Pre
power_W2 <- powerSim(
  design,
  test = fixed("weekW2", "t"),
  nsim = nsim
)

# W3 vs Pre
power_W3 <- powerSim(
  design,
  test = fixed("weekW3", "t"),
  nsim = nsim
)

# =========================
# Results
# =========================
power_W1
power_W2
power_W3


```

#calculate group sizes

```{r}
df_beh <- df %>%
  filter(behavior == "Social_interaction")

library(tidyr)

wide_df <- df_beh %>%
  select(mouse_id, week, mean_dFF) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = week, values_from = mean_dFF)

cohens_d_results <- tibble(
  comparison = c("W1", "W2", "W3"),
  d = c(
    mean(wide_df$W1 - wide_df$Preinduction, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sd(wide_df$W1 - wide_df$Preinduction, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean(wide_df$W2 - wide_df$Preinduction, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sd(wide_df$W2 - wide_df$Preinduction, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean(wide_df$W3 - wide_df$Preinduction, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sd(wide_df$W3 - wide_df$Preinduction, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

print(cohens_d_results)

sample_size_results <- cohens_d_results %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    required_n = ceiling(
      power.t.test(
        delta = cohens_d,
        sd = 1,
        sig.level = 0.05,
        power = 0.8,
        type = "one.sample"
      )$n
    )
  )

print(sample_size_results)

print(cohens_d_results)
```
